args.sql: SELECT * FROM log.main.activity_log LIMIT 10;
SELECT DISTINCT path FROM log.main.activity_log WHERE path LIKE '%detail%';
SELECT path, COUNT(*) FROM log.main.activity_log WHERE path LIKE '%detail%' GROUP BY path;
SELECT path, COUNT(*) FROM log.main.form_log WHERE path LIKE '%detail%' GROUP BY path;
SELECT path, COUNT(*) FROM log.main.activity_log GROUP BY path ORDER BY count_star() DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH sequences AS (
    SELECT
        session,
        stamp,
        path AS page1,
        LEAD(path, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS page2,
        LEAD(path, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS page3
    FROM log.main.activity_log
)
SELECT page3, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM sequences
WHERE page1 = '/detail' AND page2 = '/detail'
GROUP BY page3
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH sequences AS (

    FROM log.main.activity_log
)
SELECT page3, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM sequences
WHERE page1 = '/detail/' AND page2 = '/detail/'
GROUP BY page3
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH sequences AS (
